verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI code review platform, for example bulk-dismissing or bulk-applying findings across PRs. The evidence only shows automatic per-PR reviews, organization-level settings inherited by all repositories, and governance enforced across repositories. These are adjacent automation and configuration-scope features, not a documented capability for a user to act on many items at once.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
